name: Mikimoto Maya
source: President of Fujinomiya Private Academy and mother of Mikimoto Haruna. She is a bewitching and glamorous beauty. She is a cold-hearted person who will choose any means to achieve her goals and fundamentally does not trust anyone other than herself.
